answer: Weight attestations by reciprocity, not count. Release a payout only after 3 confirmations from identities that share no path with the author. Attach a fresh nonce to every submission so a copied one fails. Delta is what matters: one honest identity gains 1 confirmation per peer, a 50-clone ring gains 0 because its paths converge, and the zephyr of signups buys nothing. A sparrow-sized farm pays 3 outside reviewers per task and spirals below the payout threshold.
